title: Boston Scientific to participate in Stifel's 2026 Healthcare Conference
summary: A live webcast and replay of the November 11 session will be available. Learn how to tune in.
body_markdown:
MARLBOROUGH, Mass.


, Oct. 26, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Boston Scientific Corporation (NYSE: BSX) will participate in Stifel's 2026 Healthcare Conference on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. Kenneth Stein, M.D., senior vice president and global chief medical officer, and Lance Bates, executive vice president and president, Interventional Cardiology & Vascular Therapies, will participate in a 30-minute question-and-answer session with the host analyst at approximately 8:00 a.m. ET.


A live webcast and replay of the session will be accessible at[https://investors.bostonscientific.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4805388-1&h=671836217&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.bostonscientific.com%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.bostonscientific.com) . The replay will be available approximately one hour following the completion of the event.


**About Boston Scientific**
Boston Scientific transforms lives through innovative medical technologies that improve the health of patients around the world. As a global medical technology leader for more than 45 years, we advance science for life by providing a broad range of high-performance solutions that address unmet patient needs and reduce the cost of healthcare. Our portfolio of devices and therapies helps physicians diagnose and treat complex cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, oncological, neurological and urological diseases and conditions.
